visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person with curly hair and glasses, wearing a black shirt and carrying a pink tote bag, moves frantically through a blurred wet market background. They hold several plastic bags with produce. Digital blue tear emojis are overlaid on their face. The lighting is bright and natural. (2) A man in a black suit and a bob wig enters the frame and confronts the shopper. They engage in a dialogue with exaggerated facial expressions and hand gestures. The shopper looks distressed while clutching multiple shopping bags containing colorful vegetables. (3) The man in the suit presents a large purple box labeled with Chinese characters containing New Year's Eve dishes. He points at the box and then at the camera with a confident expression. The background remains the blurred outdoor market setting. (4) Fast-cut close-up shots of various gourmet dishes are shown individually, including a dark soup with abalone, sticky rice with peanuts, and a glazed pork knuckle. Yellow and red text overlays detail the dish names and promotional prices. (5) The man in the suit returns to the frame, holding the box and pointing aggressively at the camera. He wears a comical, wide-eyed expression. Yellow variety-show style captions appear on the screen to emphasize the dramatic tone of the scene. (6) A static promotional graphic displays the entire New Year's Eve dish set with several bowls and plates arranged on a festive red background. Text displays the price 3980元, a 2000 set limit, and various brand logos.

Vocal delivery becomes a rapid-fire exchange with exaggerated pitch inflections and varying loudness. (3) A whoosh sound effect marks a transition to a promotional segment. The primary male voice adopts a promotional, energetic tone, speaking clearly over the rhythmic BGM. Each new text pop-up is accompanied by a subtle digital chime sound effect. (4) The BGM continues as a male narrator describes food items with a warm, professional broadcasting tone. The speech rate slows slightly for clarity. Short transition SFX like pops or dings occur between the descriptions of the different gourmet dishes. (5) The authoritative male voice returns with a high-pitched comedic shout.
